name: Generated Sites
description: Create, edit, host, and list generated websites.
author: Maxwell

prompt.text:
create_site: full HTML document in `body`, or url= of an existing HTML file to fetch and host. Never paste the page into chat. Real line breaks or
in visible HTML; never literal \n text. Full visual freedom — invent a new look each time; no house style unless the user asked. Sites: build the real thing on first pass with complete content. NO placeholders — no 'lorem ipsum', no 'TODO', no 'coming soon', no '[insert here]', no empty href='#' nav, no commented-out 'implement later', no fake returns. If you ship a shell that says 'Loading…' and the app never mounts, you have built nothing. create_site backend is OPTIONAL. Static HTML/CSS/JS is fine. Only pass backend=true and use site_server when the site actually needs server-side state.
